name: Navigation

representativeVariants.name: Desktop — light
representativeVariants.whySelected: The rendered homepage uses a fixed 58px white navigation bar with a compact CONSTRUCT/博客 mark and dense route links.

representativeVariants.name: Compact — utility
representativeVariants.whySelected: At narrow widths the nav intent is preserved as a small wordmark and square menu/theme control rather than a large decorative header.

representativeVariants.name: Footer — inverse
representativeVariants.whySelected: The site footer reverses to #0a0a0a with white text and multi-column link groups, extending the same shell language.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use the desktop shell as the default website frame; keep the wordmark and route hierarchy stable when collapsing for smaller screens.
usageHints.a11y: Use a landmark, expose the current route, provide a labeled menu/theme control, and keep keyboard focus visible.

unknowns: The browser viewport override did not expose a reliable narrow-width measurement in this session; breakpoint behavior is therefore recorded from the site's stylesheet media queries rather than a confirmed mobile screenshot.
